regions.name: Western Cape
visual_identifiers: fynbos vegetation unique to this region
Table Mountain visible near Cape Town
specific Western Cape road sign style

state_distinguishers.Western_Cape: Most distinctive province — fynbos, Cape Dutch architecture, Mediterranean feel completely unlike rest of South Africa

regions.route_sign_clues: N2 and N1 major routes. Blue and white SA national route signs.
regions.gemini_hint: Fynbos (low shrubby heathland) + Cape Dutch whitewashed architecture = Western Cape almost certainly. Table Mountain = Cape Town area confirmed.
common_false_positives: Vineyard landscape — could be confused with Europe but fynbos and Cape Dutch architecture unique

regions.name: Gauteng and surrounds
visual_identifiers: most developed urban infrastructure in SA

state_distinguishers.Gauteng: Johannesburg/Pretoria urban area, most developed, specific N1/N3 highway infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Mpumalanga: Kruger National Park proximity, Drakensberg escarpment, Blyde River Canyon area distinctive

regions.route_sign_clues: N1, N3, N12 major routes through Gauteng. Bilingual English/Afrikaans signs.
regions.gemini_hint: Dense urban highway infrastructure = Gauteng. Dramatic escarpment = Mpumalanga. Game reserve signage = Limpopo or Mpumalanga.
common_false_positives: Highveld plateau — shared with Free State and North West

regions.name: KwaZulu-Natal

state_distinguishers.KZN_coast: Durban subtropical coast, Indian cultural influence very visible
state_distinguishers.KZN_interior: Drakensberg mountains, Zulu heartland cultural elements

regions.route_sign_clues: N2 along coast. N3 from Durban to Johannesburg.
regions.gemini_hint: Sugar cane fields + subtropical = KZN coast. Indian Ocean coastal city = Durban/KZN. Drakensberg dramatic escarpment = KZN or Mpumalanga border.
common_false_positives: Subtropical coast — could be Mozambique or similar

regions.name: Northern and Eastern Provinces
visual_identifiers: very flat open landscape in Free State

state_distinguishers.Limpopo: Baobab trees visible, game reserve infrastructure, Kruger Park proximity
state_distinguishers.Northern_Cape: Kimberley diamond mining history, Namaqualand wildflowers in season, Karoo desert landscape
state_distinguishers.Free_State: Most flat open plains, agricultural landscape, Golden Gate Highlands in east

regions.route_sign_clues: N1 through Free State and Limpopo. N10 through Eastern Cape.
regions.gemini_hint: Baobab trees = Limpopo almost certainly. Karoo flat semi-desert = Northern or Eastern Cape. Game reserve signage = Limpopo. Completely flat wheat fields = Free State.
common_false_positives: Karoo landscape — very distinctive but spans multiple provinces
Bushveld — shared between Limpopo and Mpumalanga
